title: Mode tour
goal: Put it in Loiter, then Guided, then Return to launch, then Land.

steps.text: Choose Loiter in the Cockpit tab.
steps.hint: The Cockpit tab lists the modes; Loiter holds it where it is.
Guided waits for you to tell it where to go.

steps.text: Press Return to launch in the Cockpit tab.
steps.hint: Return to launch flies it home by itself.

steps.text: Press Land in the Cockpit tab.
steps.hint: Land brings it down where it is.
